examples.english: Where then, O Egypt, where are thy consulters and horoscope-casters and those who cry | out of the earth and those who cry out of their belly?

examples.english: And thy words shall be brought down to the earth, and thy words shall sink down to the earth, and thy voice shall be as they that speak out of the earth, and thy voice shall be lowered to the ground.

examples.english: And Abenner called Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour perpetually? knowest thou not that it will be bitter at last? How long then wilt thou refuse to tell the people to turn from following our brethren?
